note: The engine ships no source text. Research needs a corpus. This file tells agents and users exactly where the reference corpus lives, how to install it, and what to do if it is unavailable.

reference_corpus.why_private: Contains third-party copyrighted texts: French working transcriptions (Staferla), a text extraction from the Seuil print edition (S1-S5), and a community Chinese translation project. Publicly readable for research access; NOT licensed for commercial use or redistribution — see RIGHTS.md.
scopes_needed: none — the repository is public; the pack downloads without a token

download.note: Plain download works (public repository). Verify with tools/fetch-corpus.py.

reference_corpus.public_note: Public repository: the pack downloads without a token. Use the plain release URL; the API asset endpoint is only needed for private forks.
reference_corpus.usage_limit: Research and study only. No commercial use, no redistribution, no re-serving, no training a publicly distributed model. The determination is the user's.

public_demo_corpus.sources: demo-corpus/sources/*.txt — Falret 1890, Binet 1892, Janet 1909 (public domain, redistributable; transcribed from fr.wikisource with their real imprint data)
public_demo_corpus.ontology: demo-corpus/ontology/spec.json → _data/ontology/v4a1/ (15 clinical entities, evidence recomputed from the demo passages)
build: python3 tools/build_demo_corpus.py .   # 段落库 → 词法/别名索引 → 语料清单 → 本体层 → 冻结/谱系（一条命令）
public_demo_corpus.what_works: 检索 → 证据充分性 → 断言 → 引文（真实段号）→ Evidence Inspector → 本体解析；例子问题：Comment la suggestion agit-elle dans l'hystérie ? → VALIDATED_WITH_QUALIFICATIONS，3 条引文
honest_limits: 没有人工验收证据：冻结状态是 CORPUS_HUMAN_REVIEW_NOT_AVAILABLE（不是 SCHOLARLY_CORE_READY）
冻结内核的 claim 归属措辞（说话人）是为参考语料写的，对本语料不适用 —— demo 承诺的是检索/证据/引文/检查器/本体解析这条链，不把 demo 答案当作可引用的学术结论
不带向量索引（向量运行时不可用）：检索走词法路径

bring_your_own.rule: The vault is the source of truth; indexes are regenerable. A different corpus requires rebuilding its own freeze (core_freeze.py --build) — never edit a frozen hash by hand.

agent_contract.check_first: python3 tools/ensure_corpus.py --status（exit 0 = 可跑研究；报告里带 corpus_profile，若是 unreviewed-corpus 则答案不带人工验收背书）

exit_codes.3: corpus missing or incomplete — ask the user

agent_contract.if_missing: Tell the user, in their language, that research needs a corpus and offer the two paths: (a) install the private reference pack if they have access to the corpus repository, or (b) build a corpus from text they are entitled to use. Do not invent passages, do not fabricate citations, and do not silently substitute model knowledge.
never: never fabricate a passage id, citation, or bibliographic field
never mirror, re-package or re-serve the corpus, or present it as licensed for reuse
never commit corpus text into this repository
never edit a frozen core hash to make a check pass
